'''April 2001 Lancaster tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Lancaster, PA on 1 April 2001. [[Jeremy Kauffman]] won it. It is known from Geoff Gallo-Cornell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2003">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-02-lancaster-pa-4-2-01d2003/ lancaster-pa-4-2-01], DeckTech (Geoff "Loaf" Gallo-Cornell, 2 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-02-lancaster-pa-4-2-01d2003/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 1 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Lancaster, PA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Jeremy Kauffman]]
